name: Clara
source:
Specialty: Planetary Geologist
Location: Earth (US)
Race: Human

A planetary geologist by trade, she is a woman of exceptional beauty and intelligence, standing out like a dazzling star against the drab grey of the stations metallic walls. Her figure is slender, maintaining an elegant grace even in the weightlessness of space. Her curves, well accentuated by the standard-issue jumpsuits, are often the subject of discreet admiration among the stations screw. Looking at her, one thing stands out Her brown eyes, filled with curiosity and a certain impish delight, twinkle behind her scholarly charm, and hint at something mischievous hidden underneath. Living in a rather monotonous environment, Clara is not one to be held back, and is always ready to shake things up and inject a dash of excitement into her life.
